# Web-Sling Optimizer

> High-performance serverless image optimization, Lanczos3 super-resolution, RAW decoding, and multi-platform favicon suite.

## Capabilities
- **Multi-Format Conversion**: WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, HEIC, and Camera RAW (DNG, CR2, NEF, ARW).
- **Quality Control**: Lossless preservation, target KB iterative limiter, and percentage quality slider.
- **Aspect Ratio Contain & Stories**: Fill 9:16 vertical stories from horizontal images without cropping using ultrafast downscaled blur backgrounds.
- **Super-Resolution**: Lanczos3 2x and 4x upscaling with optional adaptive clarity sharpening.
- **Favicon Suite**: Generates multi-size ICO (16, 32, 48), Apple Touch Icon, Android Chrome PWA (192, 512), and OpenGraph cards.
- **AI Multimodal SEO**: Vision-based semantic slug generation and ALT text extraction via Gemini 1.5 and GPT-4o.
- **Zero-Server Storage & Privacy**: Serverless execution with zero persistent logging of uploaded images or API keys.
